known_facts_book1: A yellow hen who clung to the chicken-coop when it blew off the ship and is castaway with Dorothy in the Land of Ev.
Was named 'Bill' by the farm boy who raised her; Dorothy adds 'eena' to make it the girl's name 'Billina'.
Discovers she can talk only after reaching the fairy country, and lays a fresh egg every morning about eight o'clock.
Eats bugs, ants and sand-crabs, and finds the golden key by striking it with her beak in the sand.
Spots the crack that is a door in the rock and urges Dorothy to try the golden key on it, revealing Tiktok.
Is thrown into the chicken-house by Langwidere and beats a speckled rooster in a fight.
Fights a speckled rooster and loses feathers but wins, declaring she was raised in the United States.
Hides under the Nome King's throne and overhears that the royal family are purple ornaments and the Oz people green.
Lays an egg under the throne, terrifying the egg-fearing Nome King, and bargains for her own turn at the guessing game.
Uses her overheard secret to disenchant all ten Ev royals and all the Oz captives, including Ozma the emerald grasshopper.
Nearly swallows the grasshopper that is Ozma before finding it hard and lifeless.
Tells Dorothy to seize the Nome King's belt, and whispers the egg plan to the Scarecrow.
Is given a pearl-and-sapphire necklace by King Evardo and chooses to stay in Oz rather than return to Kansas.

known_relations_book1.Dorothy: The girl she is castaway with, who renames her; her devoted friend and companion.
known_relations_book1.Nome King: Her enemy, whose secret she overhears and whose power she destroys with eggs.
known_relations_book1.Ozma: Restored by Billina from an emerald grasshopper after all others fail.
known_relations_book1.Scarecrow: Carries her on his shoulder and throws her eggs to blind the Nome King.
known_relations_book1.Queen of Ev: The queen she disenchants first from a purple footstool.
known_relations_book1.Tiktok: Fellow rescuer of Dorothy; the copper man she helps wind up and free.

not_in_this_book: Billina is eaten by the Hungry Tiger
Billina returns to Kansas with Dorothy

known_facts_book1: A round copper clockwork man made by Smith & Tinker of Evna, who thinks, speaks and acts but is not alive.
Is wound with a key in three places: number one for thinking, number two for speaking, number three for walking and action.
Was bought by the cruel King Evoldo of Ev, who beat him but could not kill him, and was locked in a rock and abandoned.
Is found and wound up by Dorothy, and declares himself her obedient servant so long as she keeps him wound.
Runs down at inconvenient moments, including mid-fight with Langwidere's soldiers after knocking down seven of them.
Uses the tin dinner-pail to beat off the Wheelers and captures their leader to learn who rules Ev.
Insists the slave should face danger before the mistress, entering the guessing palace before Dorothy.
Is transformed into a gold ornament by the Nome King and later restored by Billina.
Fitted with Smith & Tinker's Combination Steel Brains but has no heart and no conscience.
Is left in Ozma's care in Oz at the end, since his machinery would not work in the civilized world.

known_relations_book1.Dorothy: The girl who winds him up and whom he serves as faithful obedient slave.
known_relations_book1.Billina: The hen who helps him be freed and who restores him from a gold ornament.
known_relations_book1.Evoldo: His former cruel master, the King of Ev who beat him and locked him in the rock.
known_relations_book1.Scarecrow: Compares brains with him — steel combination brains against Wizard's brains.
known_relations_book1.Nome King: His captor, whose honesty he mistakenly vouches for before being transformed.

later_tome_bleed: Tiktok in the Land of Ev army against Ruggedo
not_in_this_book: Tiktok returns to Kansas with Dorothy
